expo.reason: Use the coordinated Expo 58.0.6 / React Native 0.88.0-rc.4 native dependency set under runtime 1.8.21. Preserve source guards, lifecycle regression coverage, regenerated native projects and native build validation before release.

@sentry/react-native.reason: Sentry 8.29 updates native Android/Cocoa SDKs, replay registration and iOS linking. This upgrade is coupled to runtime 1.8.14 and native project regeneration; retain crash-reporting and symbol upload validation.

react-native-gesture-handler.reason: Retain Gesture Handler 3.3 and the existing gesture API with the coordinated Expo 58 native runtime.

react-native-safe-area-context.reason: Safe-area 5.10.1 preserves the 5.10.0 Android/iOS implementation and fixes SwiftPM package metadata; validate its integration in runtime 1.8.14.

react-native-web.reason: Retain Expo 58.0.6's bundled ~0.21.3 with the guarded shared asset registry and passing Hosting/Pages exports. React Native Web 0.21.4 adds public AssetRegistry entry points and removes deprecation warnings; adopt it with a separately reviewed coordinated update.

@babel/core.reason: Babel 8.0.7 compiles mocked TypeScript and JSX test fixtures. Expo and Worklets retain the separately pinned Babel 7 adapter because their transforms still require Babel 7 APIs.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 checks the app and crash-reporting workspace. ESLint uses the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package for its compiler API.

react-native-reanimated.reason: Reanimated 4.7.1 supports React Native 0.88 and Worklets 0.13 and adds native teardown and layout-animation crash fixes. Runtime 1.8.15 regenerates native projects, rebases the callback-cleanup patch and verifies the upstream native-state guard with lifecycle tests and Android/iOS builds.

react-native.reason: React Native 0.88.0-rc.4 fixes Android Pressable accessibility-state reset and generated type augmentation. The matching Metro config, JS polyfills and transitive React Native packages are pinned together under runtime 1.8.21 with source guards and native build validation.
